description: Ranked list of Cardano native tokens traded on DEXes, for questions such as "top tokens", "biggest gainers today", "trending now" or "new pairs". Prices are in ADA and USD, volume and liquidity in ADA (24 h), market cap in USD, changes in percent. `rank` (default) combines market cap with pool liquidity and is the best general ordering; `volume` is what the site calls Trending. The answer names the floors it applied (`minLiquidityAda`, `minHolders`).

hideHighRisk.description: Leave out tokens the safety screen rates as high risk.

limit.description: How many tokens to return (1-50, default 10).

minHolders.description: Leave out tokens known to have fewer holders than this. Replaces the default floor of the ordering (100 for mcap and fdv); 0 = none.

minLiquidityAda.description: Leave out tokens with less pool liquidity than this many ADA (both sides of the pools). Replaces the default floor of the ordering; 0 = none.

order.description: Direction. Default: descending (age: ascending, youngest first). Ignored by rank, trending, new, gainers and losers.

period.description: Window of the volume, txns, change, gainers and losers orderings.

query.description: Only tokens whose ticker, name or unit starts with this text.

sort.description: Ordering. volume = traded volume over `period` (the site's Trending list); gainers/losers/change use the change of the USD price over `period` (24 h: change24hPct; change24hAdaPct is the change of the ADA price) and list only tokens traded in that window with 10,000 ADA or more of pool liquidity; mcap and fdv list only tokens with 10,000 ADA or more of liquidity and 100 or more holders; txns = number of trades over `period`; makers = traders of the last 24 h; new (= age ascending) lists tokens whose first pool was seen being created; trending = trades in the last hour.

name: list_tokens
title: Rank Cardano tokens
